packs.name: Kotlin tree-sitter
packs.description: Kotlin and Kotlin script: packages, imports, classes, objects and functions.

packs.name: C# tree-sitter
packs.description: C#: namespaces, using directives, classes, records, structs and methods.

packs.description: SQL files: tables, views and functions become part of the data layer; MySQL is recognised by its dialect.

packs.name: Astro tree-sitter

packs.name: HTML tree-sitter
packs.description: HTML pages: elements, ids, <script> and <style> blocks, and links to scripts and stylesheets. CSS inside needs the CSS extension.

packs.description: CSS stylesheets: rules, @media, @keyframes and @import. Also colours <style> blocks in HTML and Astro.
